The authenticated HTTP primary is unchanged (0/2 → 2/2 later-page tools; first-page identity control unchanged). Local full-suite timeout and baseline-reproduced locked-environment failure remain limitations, not passes. Merge still requires all exact-head CI checks to pass.

## Specific strengths
- **note-05b28a80d64719c3a47e** Pagination tests cover boundary and failure cases: The added tests cover both cursor field aliases, an empty cursor and page, duplicate/repeated cursors, catalog limits, upstream page errors, timeout behavior, and native SDK cursor serialization. This focused coverage documents the helper’s operational contract and makes future changes to pagination behavior easier to validate. Evidence: [ev-8555295a661cf74e6be71893](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1), [ev-9d2ac865d3443651c7847be9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L196).
- **note-5cac2255716dcfffeec9** Bounded, complete catalog discovery: Tool discovery follows pagination and rejects repeated cursors, duplicate tool names, catalogs above 4096 tools, and discovery beyond 128 pages; discovery is also wrapped in a timeout. These safeguards prevent incomplete or unbounded remote catalogs from being treated as ready gateway capabilities. Evidence: [ev-3da9d25ed40affbb9ce76de3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L1), [ev-d083ca9fb128b5598fa6a0e9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L413).
- **note-7dbb8fc4b3f2e6120578** Catalog discovery has explicit resource bounds: Pagination stops after 128 pages or more than 4096 tools, rejects repeated cursors, and is wrapped in a connect-timeout scope. These limits constrain catalog discovery work and prevent an unbounded or stalled upstream listing from delaying gateway readiness indefinitely. Evidence: [ev-3da9d25ed40affbb9ce76de3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L1), [ev-d083ca9fb128b5598fa6a0e9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L413).
- **note-8be9458d1114660e93b7** Pagination edge cases receive focused test-source coverage: The changed tests cover both cursor field aliases, an empty-string cursor, empty catalogs, duplicate names, repeated cursors, size/page bounds, upstream errors, timeout handling, and native SDK cursor serialization. These cases exercise compatibility and failure boundaries central to the pagination design. Evidence: [ev-8555295a661cf74e6be71893](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1), [ev-9d2ac865d3443651c7847be9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L196).
- **note-bb11ecc4b8306f86182d** Bounded, all-or-nothing catalog discovery: The gateway gathers all tool pages before registering proxies, rejects repeated cursors and duplicate names, applies page and tool-count limits, and wraps discovery in a timeout. This prevents an incomplete or unbounded remote catalog from being published as a ready gateway. Evidence: [ev-3da9d25ed40affbb9ce76de3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L1), [ev-d083ca9fb128b5598fa6a0e9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L413).
- **note-d0655bbbaf29c764e6ab** Catalog collection is isolated behind a focused helper: The new \`\_list\_remote\_tools\` helper owns pagination, duplicate detection, and page/tool limits, while the lifespan code consumes the completed catalog before registering proxies. This separation makes catalog discovery behavior easier to understand and review, and avoids mixing pagination mechanics with proxy setup. Evidence: [ev-3da9d25ed40affbb9ce76de3](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L1), [ev-d083ca9fb128b5598fa6a0e9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/slopsearx/mcp/gateway.py#L413).
- **note-d647ac92d166f4fef698** Regression tests cover pagination failure modes: The added test source checks both cursor field aliases, empty cursors, empty catalogs, repeated cursors, duplicate names, page and tool limits, upstream errors, timeout cleanup, and native SDK cursor serialization. This exercises the principal pagination and fail-closed discovery behaviors at the source level. Evidence: [ev-8555295a661cf74e6be71893](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L1), [ev-9d2ac865d3443651c7847be9](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/tests/test_mcp_gateway.py#L196).
- **note-f8073c05a1c488d448d6** Experiment scope and guardrails are explicit: The experiment description states the intended pagination behavior, bounds, failure cases, compatibility guardrails, and limits on conclusions. Explicit scope and constraints make the proposed behavior and its validation easier to review without implying unsupported production-wide benefits. Evidence: [ev-52ef9194f519fd75c05e37fd](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/docs/experiments/EXP-108-gateway-catalog-pagination.md#L1), [ev-82efb991572f0c75f199aca4](https://github.com/magnus919/SlopSearX/blob/7e8e6967595894159cacea41fe74bc630e6d1be0/docs/experiments/EXP-108-gateway-catalog-pagination.md#L1).
